passages.text: So Abram went up out of Egypt into the Negev—he and his wife and all his possessions—and Lot was with him.
passages.sermon:
Abram left Egypt.
His wife left with him.
He took all his possessions.
Lot traveled with Abram.
They went into the Negev.
passages.original: וַיַּעַל֩ אַבְרָ֨ם מִמִּצְרַ֜יִם ה֠וּא וְאִשְׁתּ֧וֹ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֛וֹ וְל֥וֹט עִמּ֖וֹ הַנֶּֽגְבָּה׃

passages.text: And Abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man.
Abram had many possessions.
Abram owned much livestock.
Abram had much silver.
Abram had much gold.
Abram was extremely wealthy.
passages.original: וְאַבְרָ֖ם כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד בַּמִּקְנֶ֕ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַזָּהָֽב׃

passages.text: From the Negev he journeyed from place to place toward Bethel, until he came to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had formerly been pitched, to the site where he had built the altar. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
Abram left the Negev region.
He traveled from place to place.
He moved toward Bethel.
He reached the area between Bethel and Ai.
Abram had set up his tent there before.
Abram had built an altar at that place earlier.
Abram went to the altar he had made.
Abram called on the name of the LORD there.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְמַסָּעָ֔יו מִנֶּ֖גֶב וְעַד־ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל עַד־ הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ הָ֨יָה שָׁ֤ם אָהֳלֹה בַּתְּחִלָּ֔ה בֵּ֥ין בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל וּבֵ֥ין הָעָֽי׃ אֶל־ מְקוֹם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ עָ֥שָׂה שָׁ֖ם בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֥א שָׁ֛ם אַבְרָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Now Lot, who was traveling with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
passages.sermon:
Lot was traveling with Abram.
Lot had flocks.
Lot had herds.
Lot had tents.
passages.original: וְגַם־ לְל֔וֹט הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ אֶת־ אַבְרָ֑ם הָיָ֥ה צֹאן־ וּבָקָ֖ר וְאֹהָלִֽים׃

passages.text: But the land was unable to support both of them while they stayed together, for they had so many possessions that they were unable to coexist.
passages.sermon:
Abram and Lot lived in the same land.
Both men had many possessions.
They owned many animals and tents.
The land could not support both of them together.
Their possessions were too great.
They could not live together in the same place.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ נָשָׂ֥א אֹתָ֛ם הָאָ֖רֶץ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־ הָיָ֤ה רְכוּשָׁם֙ רָ֔ב וְלֹ֥א יָֽכְל֖וּ לָשֶׁ֥בֶת יַחְדָּֽו׃

passages.text: And there was discord between the herdsmen of Abram and the herdsmen of Lot. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were also living in the land.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man who owned livestock.
Lot was Abram’s nephew.
Lot also owned livestock.
Abram’s herdsmen took care of his animals.
Lot’s herdsmen took care of his animals.
Abram’s herdsmen and Lot’s herdsmen argued with each other.
They had a conflict.
At that time, the Canaanites lived in the land.
The Perizzites also lived in the land.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ רִ֗יב בֵּ֚ין רֹעֵ֣י מִקְנֵֽה־ אַבְרָ֔ם וּבֵ֖ין רֹעֵ֣י מִקְנֵה־ ל֑וֹט וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י אָ֖ז יֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So Abram said to Lot, “Please let there be no contention between you and me, or between your herdsmen and my herdsmen. After all, we are brothers.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man of faith and peace.
Lot was his nephew.
Abram spoke to Lot.
Abram said, “Let there be no argument between you and me.
Let there be no argument between your herdsmen and my herdsmen.
We are men who are brothers.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל־ ל֗וֹט אַל־ נָ֨א תְהִ֤י מְרִיבָה֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔יךָ וּבֵ֥ין רֹעַ֖י וּבֵ֣ין רֹעֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־ אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אַחִ֖ים אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃

passages.text: Is not the whole land before you? Now separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; if you go to the right, I will go to the left.”
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man of peace and faith.
Abram spoke to Lot.
Abram said, "The whole land is before you.
Please separate yourself from me.
If you go to the left, I will go to the right.
If you go to the right, I will go to the left."
passages.original: הֲלֹ֤א כָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ הִפָּ֥רֶד נָ֖א מֵעָלָ֑י אִם־ הַשְּׂמֹ֣אל וְאֵימִ֔נָה וְאִם־ הַיָּמִ֖ין וְאַשְׂמְאִֽילָה׃

passages.text: And Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
passages.sermon:
Lot was Abram’s nephew.
Lot lifted his eyes.
Lot saw the whole plain of the Jordan.
The plain stretched all the way to Zoar.
The plain was well watered everywhere.
It looked like the garden of the LORD.
It looked like the land of Egypt.
This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׂא־ ל֣וֹט אֶת־ עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ כִּכַּ֣ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן כִּ֥י כֻלָּ֖הּ מַשְׁקֶ֑ה לִפְנֵ֣י׀ שַׁחֵ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ סְדֹם֙ וְאֶת־ עֲמֹרָ֔ה כְּגַן־ יְהוָה֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה צֹֽעַר׃

passages.text: So Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself and set out toward the east. And Abram and Lot parted company.
passages.sermon:
Lot was Abram’s nephew.
Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself.
Lot set out toward the east.
Abram and Lot separated from each other.
passages.original: וַיִּבְחַר־ ל֣וֹ ל֗וֹט אֵ֚ת כָּל־ כִּכַּ֣ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיִּסַּ֥ע ל֖וֹט מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיִּפָּ֣רְד֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵעַ֥ל אָחִֽיו׃

passages.text: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, but Lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
passages.sermon: Abram lived in the land of Canaan.\r\nLot lived in the cities of the plain.\r\nLot set up his tent near Sodom.
passages.original: אַבְרָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנָ֑עַן וְל֗וֹט יָשַׁב֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַכִּכָּ֔ר וַיֶּאֱהַ֖ל עַד־ סְדֹֽם׃

passages.text: But the men of Sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The men of Sodom lived in the city of Sodom.
These men acted wickedly.
They sinned greatly.
They sinned against the LORD.
passages.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י סְדֹ֔ם רָעִ֖ים וְחַטָּאִ֑ים לַיהוָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: After Lot had departed, the LORD said to Abram, “Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west, for all the land that you see, I will give to you and your offspring forever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram after Lot left him.
The LORD said, "Lift up your eyes now.
Look from the place where you are.
Look to the north.
Look to the south.
Look to the east.
Look to the west.
I will give all the land you see to you.
I will give it to your offspring forever."
passages.original: וַֽיהוָ֞ה אָמַ֣ר אֶל־ אַבְרָ֗ם אַחֲרֵי֙ הִפָּֽרֶד־ ל֣וֹט מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מִן־ הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֣ה שָׁ֑ם צָפֹ֥נָה וָנֶ֖גְבָּה וָקֵ֥דְמָה וָיָֽמָּה׃ כִּ֧י אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if one could count the dust of the earth, then your offspring could be counted.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD promised Abram many descendants.
The LORD said, “I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth.
No one can count the dust of the earth.
No one will be able to count your offspring.”
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י אֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֖ כַּעֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ אִם־ יוּכַ֣ל אִ֗ישׁ לִמְנוֹת֙ אֶת־ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ גַּֽם־ זַרְעֲךָ֖ יִמָּנֶֽה׃

passages.text: Get up and walk around the land, through its length and breadth, for I will give it to you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God had chosen Abram.
God said, “Get up.
Walk through the land.
Walk through its length.
Walk through its width.
I will give this land to you.”
passages.original: ק֚וּם הִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בָּאָ֔רֶץ לְאָרְכָּ֖הּ וּלְרָחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י לְךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
Abram moved his tent.
Abram went to live near the Oaks of Mamre.
The Oaks of Mamre are at Hebron.
Abram built an altar there.
Abram built the altar for the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ל אַבְרָ֗ם וַיָּבֹ֛א וַיֵּ֛שֶׁב בְּאֵלֹנֵ֥י מַמְרֵ֖א אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיִּֽבֶן־ שָׁ֥ם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
